files.support_desk.nl:
---
args: {}
returns: "{ id: string, kind: string }[]"
---
Among the tickets opened on or after 2026-03-14, consider those that signal that the customer may cancel or leave. For each, return { id, kind } where kind is one of "bug", "billing", "how_to", "feature_request", sorted by id. Use helpdesk.tickets() for the data. Judge what each ticket says from its text, one ticket at a time; compute counts, filters and totals exactly.
files.support_desk/ticket_kind.nl:
---
description: "Classify a support ticket."
args:
  ticket: "Ticket"
returns: "Kind"
---
Classify ticket: "bug" when something is broken, "billing" for charges and invoices, "how_to" for questions about using the product, "feature_request" for something the product does not do yet.
